issue-4610: reportRepo.create fails with "date/time field value out of range"
Opened by integrations-team-dk on 2026-11-05

Our script creates one report per client per month through
`POST /api/v1/reports`. A bug on our side made it ask for February 2027 with
`"to": "2027-02-29"`, and the API answer

args.query: date/time field value out of range

result: {"query": "date/time field value out of range", "query_valid": true, "count": 0, "truncated": false, "index_age": "50 days ago", "results": []}
{"query": "source code concerning Ledgerline", "query_valid": true, "count": 0, "truncated": false, "index_age": "50 days ago", "results": []}
label: '$fill'; a label is at most 40 characters of lower-case letters, digits, - _ and /, such as bug. Fix the arguments and call again.
